name: pdf-view
author: lumine-code
description: View PDF files directly in the editor.
backgroundTips: You can search inside a PDF you are reading with {{ 'pdf-view:find' | keystroke }}
You can reach a PDF's outline and page thumbnails with {{ 'pdf-view:toggle-sidebar' | keystroke }}

autoRefresh.title: Auto-reload on update
autoRefresh.description: Automatically reload when the file is updated. The window can be refreshed manually by press `F5` in pdf-view.

autoTime.title: Auto-refresh delay
autoTime.description: The time in ms before reloading the pdf-view after the last detected change.

defaultZoom.title: Default zoom
defaultZoom.description: The default zoom level when opening a PDF.

defaultSidebar.title: Default sidebar
defaultSidebar.description: The default sidebar view when opening a PDF.

snoFilter.title: Filter section numbers
snoFilter.description: Remove leading section numbers from PDF outline entries in navigation-panel.

scrollmap.title: Scrollmap
scrollmap.description: Show PDF outline markers on the scrollbar when scrollmap is installed.

maxDepth.title: Max Depth
maxDepth.description: Maximum outline depth to show. Zero means no limit.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Hide markers if count exceeds this value. Zero means no limit.
